items.text: Removed the workshop refresh button binding option in the settings. This prevents a possible workshop refresh bug when trying to access the workshop.
Fixed the Minotaur shoulder pad and the missing ice giant belt.
Right Banshee upper arm bands can now be coloured in the unit creator.
We also Improved the unsupported props messaging in game to make it clearer which units are causing the problems:

Factions that contain unsupported units can now be added to the faction bar. However, when attempting to place an unsupported unit a new error message will show explaining how to fix the unsupported unit.
Alternatively, you can disable the unsupported unit safety checks in the Gameplay settings menu using the Validate Custom Content setting.
Certain mods were causing a "file linked expired" error message to appear. Several reported mods have been fixed but if you experience this with any other mods please do report these to us :)

notes.title: Hello everyone! As promised, here's a bug patch and quality-of-life update for TABS!

items.text: TABS just turned 8 years old earlier this month, it's wild to think that so many of you have been following this game for that long. We're eternally grateful to you all for playing, providing feedback and suggestions to make the game better and we're excited to keep seeing what you create and share!

As we announced back in 2022 we will no longer be adding more content to the game after the small neon update earlier this year. This Quality of Life Patch is most likely also the last major bug patch to be released for the game. You can read the 2022 post explaining why here

For those of you who missed it, we released a new game in April called Content Warning where you film your friends doing scary things to become SpöökTube famous! You can find the game here

We're also working on a new game called HASTE: Broken Worlds where you run fast, leap through the air, and perfect your landings as you try again and again to make your way through an infinite number of worlds falling apart behind you! You can check out HASTE here.

releases.displayName: UPDATE: Neon weapons, colors, and abilities!

items.text: Hello everyone! It’s been a while but we’re happy to finally have the Neon-inspired stuff ready for the Unit Creator!
This update includes 20 new weapons, neon abilities, some neon head-pieces and neon colors for the Unit Creator.

This update is the last planned update for TABS as detailed in the roadmap, we will keep track of any accidental bugs introduced in this build for future patches but past this update, we have no plans for more content for the game.
We’re immensely grateful to you all for joining us on this journey over the last 7,5 years! It’s bittersweet to finally be able to release this update.

It has been amazing to see this community grow and create your own factions, units, and external mods that will keep the game fresh forever. If you’re curious as to why we’re not planning any further updates we have spoken about the reasons on the roadmap page.

We’re currently working on a couple of new games, one of which is HASTE: Broken Worlds - a game where you run fast, leap through the air, and perfect your landings as you try again and again to make your way through an infinite number of worlds falling apart behind you!
You can wishlist the game on Steam.

Neon materials can be assigned to most unit meshes using the unit creator.

UCG is now versioned to prevent issues with incompatibility.
Fixed some shaders.

Various other fixes
Make sure to restart Steam and verify the integrity of the game files!
Enjoy,

notes.title: Some facts to keep in mind

items.text: This beta is Windows only as we want to focus on finishing the whole update for all platforms.
The first beta announcement has a Steam end date on the 30th of December - this is not correct as we will end the beta once the update is released - we currently don't know which date that will be.
You will be able to save your units but you will not be able to share them with others during the beta - but this will be possible when we release the update.
There are some clothes and weapons not currently available in the beta build that will be available later.
We’re looking into how to make the workshop better so it’s currently disabled.
It’s a beta - so a lot of things can change before the full release of the update.
We’re currently running the beta on Steam only but the full update will be released on Epic and Xbox.
If you have any questions or feedback please post them in the steam forums or email info@landfall.se
The estimate is still for us to release the full update for the Unit Creator sometime in Q4 (October-December) but this may change at any time.

releases.displayName: A little update from the devs!

items.text: Hello Everyone! Here’s a little update from us developers.

We’re currently all working from home as the COVID-19 pandemic is hitting Sweden and Germany harder than expected. Currently, most of the team are healthy but some of us are sick. We’re doing our best to not let it affect our update schedule - that said we cannot say if it will cause some delays further down the road. If so, we’ll keep you posted.

The next update will most likely be in April, we have some very exciting stuff that we can’t wait for you to play! :D The reason we haven’t released any dev-clips or info about the coming updates lately is that we have a lot of surprises in store for you, we think the wait and secrecy will be worth it, we hope you do too.
Stay safe out there, practise social distancing, wash your hands and show compassion for others!

Love is in the air! <3 We hope you're all enjoying the new decade and the new update, we're super excited to bring you even more content in 2020. Here's what's coming next: https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791455606666/announcements/detail/3742991449199556207

notes.title: Some facts to keep in mind

items.text: This beta is Windows only as we want to focus on finishing the whole update for all platforms.
The first beta announcement has a Steam end date on the 30th of December - this is not correct as we will end the beta once the update is released - we currently don't know which date that will be.
You will be able to save your units but you will not be able to share them with others during the beta - but this will be possible when we release the update.
There are some clothes and weapons not currently available in the beta build that will be available later.
We’re looking into how to make the workshop better so it’s currently disabled.
It’s a beta - so a lot of things can change before the full release of the update.
We’re currently running the beta on Steam only but the full update will be released on Epic and Xbox as well.
If you have any questions or feedback please post them in the steam forums or email info@landfall.se
The estimate is still for us to release the full update for the Unit Creator sometime in Q4 (October-December) but this may change at any time.

items.text: Hello everyone! We know you’re excited for the next update but unfortunately, we’ve been having some issues with our engine that have made it impossible for us to deliver the 0.4 update up to the same standards as we want to in June.

Therefore we’re not going live with the update this week BUT we are going to open up the Battle and Campaign creator on a beta branch for everyone early next week with the hope of doing the full update soon.
We hope you all have a nice weekend! Here's a new video of development clips from the last month, enjoy!

You can control units by looking at them and pressing F - holding F makes it easier to choose which unit, just let go when you've marked the one you want to possess.

Control the unit by walking/running/driving with the WASD keys, use attacks with LMB and RMB (mouse clicks) and do special moves with space. All units don't have attacks or special moves so it varies from unit to unit. Use C to switch between first and third person view.
Remember, you're possessing the unit - this means will be just as bad (and probably worse) as the unit usually is!
